sections.title: From ODEs to PDEs: A Visual Shift
lecture_lines: ODEs track change in one variable.
PDEs model change in many variables.
Think of space and time together.
animations: Create a single point representing an ODE solution using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ball.svg].
Expand the point into a dynamic wave pattern to represent a PDE.
Morph the wave pattern into a 2D surface.
Highlight the transition point between 1D and 2D using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drum.svg].

sections.title: Core Concept: The Heat Equation
lecture_lines: Heat moves from hot to cold.
animations: Display the heat equation formula in #FF5733 alongside a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/thermometer.svg].
Animate particles moving from high concentration to low concentration using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/molecule.svg].
Demonstrate smoothing of a jagged line into a smooth curve.

sections.title: The Wave Equation: Nature's Rhythm
animations: Display the wave equation formula in #33FF57.
Show a vibrating string with fixed endpoints at #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/string.svg].
Visualize the propagation of a peak along the string.

animations: Show a grid representing the spatial domain.
